title: Sliding Puzzle
prompt:
Build the 15-puzzle on a 4x4 board. start() shuffles the solved board with 200 seeded random legal moves and never deals an already solved board. Sliding a tile into the blank is a move; the order 1..15 followed by the blank is solved: solved true, score = max(100, 1000 - moves), phase 'over', and further moves are ignored. Keyboard: arrows slide (ArrowLeft = slide('left')). Touch/mouse: tap or click a tile next to the blank.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, size:4, moves, solved, tiles (16 numbers, row-major, 0 = blank)}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.slide(dir): move the tile next to the blank in that direction into it: 'left' moves the tile right of the blank left, 'up' moves the tile below the blank up; returns false when there is none
- Game.input.tap(col, row): slide that tile if it is next to the blank, else return false
- Game.cellCenter(col, row): canvas point of a cell
- Game.debug.setTiles(tiles): set the 16 tiles exactly

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): solvable shuffles, slide directions, invalid slides, taps, solving, seeded deals, keyboard, touch and click.
